supporting_observations.claim: The recurring connections occurred through the internal proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080, rather than providing evidence of direct outbound HTTPS connections from the workstation. Zeek records show proxy connections at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:41 through 14:06 UTC.

At 14:10:59 UTC, the proxy recorded a CONNECT to update.chartmate-imaging.com:443, and endpoint network telemetry attributes the corresponding connection to C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe. This is consistent with the inventory's approved ChartMate updater and its approximately five-minute update checks.

The records show a successful network logon for lucy.park on WS-LPARK-01 from WS-BCARTER-01's IP address; the domain controller also issued Lucy-related Kerberos tickets from that address. The evidence does not establish why her credentials were used from this workstation.

Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched in Ben Carter's session, and its Cisco-signed DLL was loaded. This is noteworthy given the inventory says there is no VPN, but these records do not show a VPN connection or tunnel.
An SMB connection from WS-BCARTER-01 to DC-HD-01 coincided with an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. The available records do not show which share or files, if any, were accessed.

known_telemetry_limitations: Most recurring proxy connections have Zeek connection records but no supplied proxy destination or process attribution; the ChartMate attribution is directly available for the 14:10:59 connection.
The supplied records do not show the contents of the ChartMate TLS session.
The records show the AnyConnect UI launch and signed module load, but not whether a VPN tunnel was established.
The SMB connection records do not identify accessed shares or files, and the supplied evidence does not show whether any data was read or changed.
claims_not_established: Whether Lucy Park's credentials were used with her authorization or whether the logon was related to approved help-desk work.
Whether Cisco AnyConnect was merely present or launched, or was used to establish an unauthorized remote-access connection.
Whether the anonymous SMB session accessed any resources or resulted in data exposure.
Whether any malicious process, persistence, data staging, or exfiltration occurred on WS-BCARTER-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify with Lucy Park and the help-desk records whether her logon to WS-LPARK-01 from WS-BCARTER-01 was expected; review domain account creation and group-change audit records for the interval.
Collect VPN client connection, profile, and service logs, plus installation provenance, to determine whether AnyConnect established a tunnel or was unauthorized.
Review DC-HD-01 SMB share-access and object-access auditing for the 13:58:59 UTC session.
Obtain complete proxy logs and endpoint process-to-network telemetry for all recurring connections, and validate the ChartMate updater executable and destination against approved software records.
